self_assessment: instance_id's hash (0415e42) is the verbatim upstream fix commit ('mfa: support multiple U2F keys on CLI login (#5484)'); base_commit is a direct ancestor and the commit applies cleanly. IdentityService interface) and lib/web/sessions.go so all implementations/callers stay consistent, lib/client/weblogin.go handles both legacy single-challenge and new multi-challenge wire formats and passes all challenges to the already-variadic u2f.AuthenticateSignChallenge, and tool/tsh/mfa.go hides the ls/add/rm MFA subcommands per the requirement to keep device management hidden until the feature is complete.
